exercises: SOURCE DEST form copies source content to a new dest file
expected: DEST exists and holds SOURCE content
manpage_quote: Copy SOURCE to DEST, or multiple SOURCE(s) to DIRECTORY.

exercises: -r copies a directory tree including nested files
manpage_quote:
-R, -r, --recursive
              copy directories recursively

exercises: SOURCE... DIRECTORY form places each source by basename in DIRECTORY
expected: both a.txt and b.txt present inside DIRECTORY
manpage_quote: cp [OPTION]... SOURCE... DIRECTORY

exercises: -n leaves an existing destination unchanged
manpage_quote:
-n, --no-clobber
              (deprecated) silently skip existing files.  See also --update

exercises: -f is ignored when -n is also present, so existing DEST is not overwritten
manpage_quote:
-f, --force
              if an existing destination file cannot be opened, remove it and
              try again (this option is ignored when the -n option is also
              used)

exercises: -i overrides a previous -n; answering the prompt yes overwrites DEST
expected: DEST overwritten with NEW after yes
manpage_quote:
-i, --interactive
              prompt before overwrite (overrides a previous -n option)

exercises: -b backs up an existing destination using the default '~' suffix
expected: backup file DEST~ holds old DEST content
manpage_quote:
The backup suffix is '~', unless set with --suffix or
       SIMPLE_BACKUP_SUFFIX.

exercises: --suffix overrides the backup suffix used by --backup
expected: backup file DEST.bak holds old DEST content
manpage_quote:
-S, --suffix=SUFFIX
              override the usual backup suffix

exercises: --backup=none makes no backup even though backup was requested
manpage_quote:
none, off
              never make backups (even if --backup is given)

exercises: -l hard links the destination to the source instead of copying
expected: DEST and SOURCE share one inode
manpage_quote:
-l, --link
              hard link files instead of copying

exercises: -s creates a symbolic link at the destination instead of copying
manpage_quote:
-s, --symbolic-link
              make symbolic links instead of copying

exercises: --remove-destination removes a read-only existing dest before opening
manpage_quote:
--remove-destination
              remove each existing destination file before attempting to open
              it (contrast with --force)

exercises: -u does not replace a destination newer than the source
manpage_quote:
'older' is the default operation when --update is specified, and
       results in files being replaced if they're older than the corresponding
       source file.

exercises: -u replaces a destination older than the source
expected: older DEST replaced with NEW content
manpage_quote:
'older' is the default operation when --update is specified, and
       results in files being replaced if they're older than the corresponding
       source file.

exercises: --update=none-fail makes a skipped existing file induce a failure
expected: nonzero exit on the skipped existing DEST
manpage_quote:
'none-fail' also ensures no files are replaced in the
       destination, but any skipped files are diagnosed and induce a failure.

exercises: -T treats DEST as a normal file; an existing directory DEST cannot receive a regular-file SOURCE
manpage_quote:
-T, --no-target-directory
              treat DEST as a normal file

exercises: single SOURCE with an existing DIRECTORY dest lands at DIRECTORY/basename
manpage_quote: Copy SOURCE to DEST, or multiple SOURCE(s) to DIRECTORY.

exercises: --strip-trailing-slashes lets a regular-file SOURCE given with a trailing slash copy
manpage_quote:
--strip-trailing-slashes
              remove any trailing slashes from each SOURCE argument

exercises: --parents recreates the full source path under DIRECTORY
manpage_quote:
--parents
              use full source file name under DIRECTORY

exercises: directory SOURCE copied into an existing DIRECTORY is nested as a child
manpage_quote: Copy SOURCE to DEST, or multiple SOURCE(s) to DIRECTORY.

exercises: -t with a non-directory target violates the DIRECTORY contract
manpage_quote:
-t, --target-directory=DIRECTORY
              copy all SOURCE arguments into DIRECTORY

exercises: two SOURCEs with a non-directory final argument violates the SOURCE... DIRECTORY form
manpage_quote: cp [OPTION]... SOURCE... DIRECTORY
